title: Translational Potential of ex Vivo Gene Therapy in GM2 Gangliosidosis
official: Translational Potential of ex Vivo Gene Therapy in GM2 Gangliosidosis
summary: The project aims to optimize and validate this new therapeutic strategy using cells from GM2 patients to evaluate the cross-correction of neurons in vitro by the culture medium of genetically modified myeloid cell lines. The ultimate goal is to demonstrate the potential of CHS-TGEX as an effective treatment in humans for GM2 gangliosidosis.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Proven diagnosis of GM2 gangliosidosis (decreased β-hexosaminidase enzyme activity and/or biallelic pathogenic variants in the HEXA or HEXB gene)
* Age ≥ 5 years
* Blood sample planned as part of treatment

Exclusion Criteria:

* Opposition from the patient or legal guardians
* Contraindication to venous sampling
* Patient under guardianship or curatorship
* Patient not covered by social security
* Patient covered by AME (State Medical Aid)
* Weight \< 25 kg for minor patients
